profile_text.body:
Gong is a for-profit startup founded in 2015 and headquartered in Palo Alto, CA. The company describes itself as offering a "Revenue AI OS" aimed at go-to-market organizations, built around what it calls multimodal revenue signal processing, specialized AI agents, and purpose-built sales applications. Its stated use cases include closing deals faster, predicting pipeline risk, automating handoffs, increasing win rates, and reducing customer churn.

Gong's core product is its revenue intelligence platform, which the site presents as covering call analysis, deal coaching, sales engagement, and customer success. Named product lines include Gong Engage, described as a tool for prioritizing and personalizing sales communications, and Gong Enable, which includes an AI Trainer feature the company says allows sales teams to create training grounded in their own customer conversations. The site includes a customer claim of saving 6,700 hours across call prep, follow-up, and CRM updates, and a 32% lift in buyer response rates attributed to Gong's AI Tracker agent.

The site's held facts classify Gong's product under the Notes, Knowledge, and Meetings category, with a note flagging potential sensitive sales data exposure as a consideration. No litigation is on record for the company in the held facts. Three MCP server entries appear in the registry under names referencing SQLite database tooling, though these appear to be third-party or community-built tools rather than official Gong products.
